description: Extract the text of a PDF page by page as plain text or Markdown, with page selection, an optional layout-preserving mode and the document metadata. Cost in credits: ceil(pages extracted / 20), minimum 1. File input (file): base64 string, data: URI or {"url": "https://..."}. Output: JSON. {page_count, pages: [{n, text}] (Markdown: [{n, markdown}]), chars, metadata: {title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, created, modified}}; meta.note when the PDF has no text layer.

file.description: The PDF: base64 string (or data: URI) or {"url": "https://..."}. Up to 10 MB.

format.description: text: the plain text of each page. markdown: headings, bold and italic, lists and paragraphs as Markdown, page headers and footers that repeat on most pages left out (layout does not apply).

layout.description: Preserve the visual layout (columns, spacing) instead of reading order.

pages.description: Pages to extract, e.g. '1-3,7' or '5-' (default: all pages).

name: pdf_text
title: PDF text extractor
